decisions.reason: The multi-model formwork profile system is a core consumable line for precast plants and fits the established offer, so it stays despite not being seen on the website in 2020 to 2021.
Automated concrete distributor flow control supports the firm's automation strategy and is probably now built into its integrated plant packages rather than marketed separately.
Shuttering magnet blocks are standard recurring-demand items for precast customers and are cheap to keep in the range.
The magnetic formwork strips are an established multi-model line close to the core business that brings steady replacement sales.
This single magnetic formwork component complements the magnet range at low cost, though overlap with similar items makes consolidation somewhat more likely than for the other lines.
